# graphiant_playbook_configs (Data Source)

Automation Workflows playbook configs (the Portal's Pending Executions table), with each config's latest job status. All pages are fetched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_playbook_configs" "staged" {
  statuses = ["STAGED"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring match on config name.
- `statuses` (List of String) Only return configs in these statuses (e.g. STAGED, PAUSED).

### Read-Only

- `configs` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configs))

<a id="nestedatt--configs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configs`

Read-Only:

- `config_id` (String)
- `created_by_user_id` (String)
- `job_status` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `run_id` (String)
- `run_number` (Number)
- `started_at` (String)
- `started_by_user_id` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
